query: What recruitment strategies, realistic inclusion/exclusion criteria, facilitator competency benchmarks, training curriculum (hours/modules), and budget/timeline estimates are needed to run a pilot of ~60–80 participants?

response.query: What recruitment strategies, realistic inclusion/exclusion criteria, facilitator competency benchmarks, training curriculum (hours/modules), and budget/timeline estimates are needed to run a pilot of ~60–80 participants?
response.answer: Recruitment strategies include targeted outreach and partnerships; inclusion/exclusion criteria focus on relevant experience and skills; facilitator competency benchmarks require advanced training; budget estimates are $500,000-$750,000 for 6 months.

results.title: Chapter 10 - Security Assistance Management Manual
results.content: C10.3.2.New or first time requests for potentially sensitive or lethal training under International Military Education and Training (IMET) and Foreign Military Sales (FMS) programs must be staffed through the Security Cooperation Organization (SCO), the Combatant Command (CCMD), and the Military Department (MILDEP) to the DSCA (Office of International Operations (IOPS)) for coordination and approval by the Under Secretary of Defense for Policy (USD(P)) and the Department of State (State), Bureau of Political and Military Affairs Office (State (PM)). C10.6.2.2.DSCA (Defense Security Cooperation University, International Military Training and Education Division (DSCU/IMTE)) provides IMET program implementation policy to the Combatant Commands (CCMDs), MILDEPs and Security Cooperation Organizations (SCOs). C10.6.6.1.At each CCMD SCETWG, IMET training requirements that have been programmed into Defense Security Assistance Management System - Training Module (DSAMS-TM) by the MILDEPs for the current fiscal year (FY) (to include one-year, two-year, x-year, and de-obligation/re-obligation IMET) and budgetFY (next FY) are reviewed by the CCMD, State, DSCA (DSCU/IMTE) and the SCO to ensure the appropriateness of IMET funding.
